entries.title: Recognizing basic time-domain signal operations
entries.description: distinguish among shifting, scaling, and reversal as three different signal transformations.

entries.title: Interpreting time shifting
entries.description: understand that shifting moves a signal left or right without changing its basic shape.

entries.title: Delaying a signal
entries.description: apply $x(t-T)$ and interpret it as shifting the signal right by $T$.

entries.title: Advancing a signal
entries.description: apply $x(t+T)$ and interpret it as shifting the signal left by $T$.

entries.title: Reading shift direction from the sign
entries.description: determine whether a form like $x(t-a)$ represents a delay or an advance.
